label: Auth Pages
description: Complete sign-in flow behind a Page Router: Sign In, Sign Up, Forgot Password and Reset Password pages built on the built-in Log In, Sign Up, Request Password Reset and Reset Password nodes. Labelled email/password inputs, inline error text from each node's Error output, loading state on every submit button, and links between the pages. Fires an "Auth Success" event when a user signs in or signs up.
